test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Please bring some milk from _____ refrigerator in the kitchen.
solution:
The correct answer is '**the**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The article "**the**" is used before a noun to specify something particular or already known to the speaker and listener.
 
• In this sentence, the refrigerator in the kitchen is specific, hence the article "**the**" is appropriate.
 
• **Options 2, 3**, and **4 **do not fit the context, as they are either indefinite or incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Please bring some milk from **the**__ refrigerator in the kitchen."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "a"** is incorrect because it refers to any refrigerator, not a specific one.
 
• **Option 3: "an"** is incorrect because "an" is used before words starting with vowel sounds, which is not applicable here.
 
• **Option 4: "No article required"** is incorrect because the sentence requires specification of the refrigerator.
